definition: Gemini Assistant is the built-in AI on Android phones. It answers questions, sets timers, and controls your device by voice.
extendedDescription:
If you hold the power button on a modern Android phone, you get Gemini Assistant. It handles the classic phone jobs: calling people, setting alarms, playing music, answering quick questions, and toggling device settings.

It is a device assistant, not a work assistant. It does not triage your inbox, prepare meeting briefs, or manage projects across your tools. When the phone goes in your pocket, its help stops.

This page is about the on-phone assistant. Google's Gemini chatbot and the older Google Assistant are covered on their own pages.

faqs.answer: Gemini Assistant is the voice assistant built into Android phones. It handles calls, timers, device settings, and quick questions by voice.
faqs.question: What is Gemini Assistant?

faqs.answer: Gemini Assistant runs your phone. GAIA runs your work: email triage, calendar management, task follow-through, and memory across all your tools.
faqs.question: How is Gemini Assistant different from GAIA?

howGaiaUsesIt: GAIA picks up where the phone assistant stops. It reads your Gmail, prepares briefings before meetings, creates tasks from conversations, and remembers context across weeks. Use your voice for timers and calls; use GAIA for everything that spans more than one app.
metaDescription: Gemini Assistant is the AI on Android phones for voice commands. Learn what it covers and where a full open-source assistant takes over.
metaTitle: What Is Gemini Assistant? Phone AI Explained
